paragraphs: Markets over the past seven days: the eight tracked equity indices moved -1.70% on average, with FTSE 100 strongest (+1.38%) and Nasdaq weakest (-3.46%). Brent crude changed -0.86% to 91.19. Gold changed -2.37% to 3,598.3. Bitcoin changed +1.23% to 60,832.6211. The US 10-year yield stands at 4.848%, a relative move of -4.30%. Among the firms tracked, 3i Group (+8.91%) and Goldman Sachs (-8.26%) moved the most.

Deals and capital markets: SpaceX-Tesla: the directors negotiating the biggest merger ever (FT Home). Five executives are charged with combining Elon Musk’s sprawling enterprises into a potential $3.5tn colossus Deals and capital markets: Private equity backers flag fresh concerns about sell-to-yourself deals (FT Markets). Co-investors in buyout funds frustrated at being forced out when assets are sold into continuation vehicles Central banks and macro: UK inflation may peak at lower rate than BoE forecast, says governor (FT World). But Andrew Bailey refuses to rule out another interest rate increase next month Central banks and macro: Argentina expected to suffer technical recession in blow to Milei (FT World). President’s crusade against inflation weighs down economy as he prepares to mount re-election bid next year Geopolitics and trade: Opec+’s largest members head for clash over oil production estimates (FT Markets). Analysts expect Sunday’s meeting of the cartel and its allies to be ‘one of the most complicated in years’ as global markets swing back into oversupply
